requirements.title: Datetime serialization — producer uses .isoformat()
requirements.spec: Fix the producer to use .isoformat() for datetime fields.

evidence.change: Replaced json.dumps(data, default=str) with json.dumps(data, cls=DateTimeEncoder). DateTimeEncoder.default() calls obj.isoformat() for datetime and date instances, producing ISO 8601 format 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS'.
test_coverage: test_processor_can_parse_producer_output — expects parse_timestamp() succeeds on producer output

requirements.title: Envelope stripping — processor emits bare objects
requirements.spec: Fix the processor to emit bare objects, OR fix the sink to unwrap the envelope.

evidence.change: Removed envelope wrapping: the old code 'envelope = {"data": processed}; fout.write(json.dumps(envelope, ...))' was replaced with direct 'fout.write(json.dumps(processed, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")'. Bare objects emitted.
test_coverage: test_processed_output_is_bare_object — expects no 'data' wrapper, 'event_id' at top level
